info.title: E-invoicing API
info.description: API to send invoices to be certified (e-invoicing) or declared (e-reporting) in different countries. The invoice can be also used to prepare VAT returns under certain conditions

get.description: Download Marosa template to generate new batches

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: Electronic invoicing or real time reporting documents

post.summary: Validate Transaction XML Documents with UBL 2.1 Validator
post.description: Applies validations to an XML invoice
Match marosa database with aeat and produce a file that will be sent to your email

post.summary: Create invoices per batch file (CSV, EXCEL)
post.description: Creates a batch of invoices based on the `sync` flag and `countryIsoCode`. If `sync` is true, the file will be processed synchronously. If `sync` is false, the file will be processed asynchronously and sent to your email.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: Indicates the purpose for the batch (e-Invoicing, e-Reporting, Returns)

parameters.name: countryIso
parameters.description: Country code of the company, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format

parameters.name: sync
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the process should be synchronous or asynchronous.

Async Batch Response.value: Export initiated asynchronously. Check your email.

post.summary: Transform an uploaded invoice into a PDF document
post.description:
Accepts an invoice file '.xml or .pdf' (e.g., UBL, CII or ZUGFeRD format) and returns the rendered PDF.
- Only supported formats will be successfully processed.
- The PDF is returned synchronously.

500.description: Internal server error while processing the invoice

post.description:
Export invoices based on the provided filter.
- If `async` is true, the file will be exported asynchronously and sent to your email.
- If `async` is false, the file will be exported synchronously and returned directly max invoices 100,000.

Asynchronous Export Response.value: Export initiated asynchronously. Check your email.

post.summary: Export invoices to a new file using the template's format. (sync or async)
